title: CallTypeTaxonomy
description: The taxonomy the classifier chooses from. Mirrors how real call-intelligence tools label calls: a small set of mutually-exclusive call types, each tagged pre-sales vs post-sales, each pointing at the scorecard(s) and default outcomes that apply.

phase.description: pre-sales = winning the deal; post-sales = expanding/retaining; neither = internal/partner/investor/interview.

definition.description: Crisp definition the classifier uses to decide. Written like a label option's instructions.

positive_signals.description: Cues that this is the right call type.

negative_signals.description: Cues that point AWAY from this call type (disambiguation against neighbors).

often_confused_with.description: Sibling call-type ids that look similar, with how to tell them apart handled in the classifier prompt.

scorecards.description: Scorecard ids to run when a call is classified as this type.

default_outcomes.description: Outcome ids (see config/outcomes.yaml) typically desired for this call type. The outcome step refines these from the actual content.
